major_concerns: Emulated vendor syntaxes may underrepresent vendor-specific failure modes.
Verifier rule coverage could bias perceived GVR effectiveness.
Task-bank size and subgroup power not justified statistically.
Model nondeterminism and retry policy need stronger controls.
required_design_repairs: Increase fidelity of vendor-syntax emulation (sample real device snippets or vendor templates) and document limits.
Preregister verifier rule set and quantitative coverage/limitations; include unit tests for verifier behaviors.
Provide power/sample-size calculation for protocol/modality subgroups and adjust task bank accordingly.
Specify seed/control for model nondeterminism, retry policy, and logging for all reruns.

major_concerns: Retrieval-corpus curation can strongly bias RAG results and is underspecified.
Deterministic verifiers may cause false positives that alter measured utility without cost accounting.
Mininet may not expose hardware/vendor-specific retrieval implications.
Evaluation conflates retrieval quality with verifier thresholds unless disentangled.
required_design_repairs: Define and publish corpus-curation policy (sources, licenses, inclusion criteria) and run sensitivity ablations to corpus content.
Calibrate and preregister verifier thresholds; report false-positive/false-negative rates and decision costs.
Include ablation separating retrieval vs verifier contributions (LLM+RAG without verifier, verifier-only checks).
Add retrieval-relevance metrics (e.g., MRR) and correlate with deployment outcomes; preregister analysis plan.

major_concerns: Operator-behavior models are synthetic and may not reflect real reviewer decision distributions.
Policy Pareto-front conclusions are sensitive to chosen operator-parameter grids.
Mininet/automation simplifications may distort latency–safety trade-offs.
Risk of overgeneralizing simulation outcomes to organizational contexts.
required_design_repairs: Justify operator-model priors (literature or operational logs) or expand sensitivity sweeps to extreme realistic ranges.
Preregister the operator-parameter grid and include robustness checks showing where conclusions change.
Augment simulation with case studies or expert-validated scenarios to anchor realism (no human-subject data needed).
Report decision-cost accounting (operator time) alongside failure metrics and clarify organizational applicability limits.

major_concerns: Benchmark scoring weights and composite Safety Score choices may unduly influence rankings.
Resource cost and maintenance burden for community reproducibility not fully addressed.
Task and vendor representativeness risks gaming or overfitting to the benchmark.
Licensing of corpora and verifier tools may limit reuse.
required_design_repairs: Specify and justify scoring weight choices and provide alternative-weight sensitivity analyses.
Include a maintenance/governance plan and a lightweight pilot benchmark to validate costs and running-time estimates.
Ensure task selection stratification across vendors/protocols and document representativeness criteria; publish clear anti-overfitting guidance.
Resolve licensing and dependency issues up-front and publish artifacts under permissive/licenses-compatible terms with hashes.
